name: SOL Vomma
description: A few minutes before each 15-minute SOL market closes, read how much movement the price implies (implied vol) and compare it with a forecast from recent SOL price action. When the market expects much more movement than is likely, the side that's currently winning is too cheap, so buy it. (Started as a vol-of-vol / vomma pricing idea; research showed that correction is too small to trade, the vol-level error is what's left.)
hypothesis: Thin KXSOL15M traders don't price vol uncertainty (vomma) and overprice short-horizon vol. Research: the vomma mixture correction is <1c, below fee+spread, so the tradable part is the vol level: when implied/forecast vol is in the top 30%, favourites are underpriced (~+1c/contract after fees at real next fills in both halves of dev data). Wrong if walk-forward months are mostly negative or the pooled CI is below 0.
